translation: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall
The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off
(A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent

arabic: تَعۡرُجُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمٖ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥ خَمۡسِينَ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٖ
translation: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years
Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment)
They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event)
But We see it (quite) near
The Day that the sky will be like molten brass
And the mountains will be like wool
And no friend will ask after a friend

arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمۡۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ يَفۡتَدِي مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِئِذِۭ بِبَنِيهِ
translation: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children
His wife and his brother
His kindred who sheltered him

arabic: وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
translation: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him
By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell
Plucking out (his being) right to the skull
Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right)
And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)
Truly man was created very impatient
Fretful when evil touches him
And niggardly when good reaches him
Not so those devoted to Prayer
Those who remain steadfast to their prayer
And those in whose wealth is a recognised right
For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking)
And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
translation: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord
For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity
And those who guard their chastity

arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed

arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ
translation: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors
And those who respect their trusts and covenants
And those who stand firm in their testimonies
And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship
Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss)
Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee
From the right and from the left, in crowds

arabic: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٖ
translation: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss
By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know

arabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
translation: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly

arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
translation: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan)

arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
translation: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised

arabic: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعٗا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٖ يُوفِضُونَ
translation: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them)

arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
translation: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised
